title: Video Style
description: Defining and maintaining a coherent audiovisual style: look, tone, motion language, typography, and brand fit.
summary: Video style is the consistent system of visual and sonic choices—lighting mood, color, lens language, motion, type, and edit feel—that expresses brand personality and story tone.
